name: tueste-academico
description: Prototipo académico full stack de referidos para Tueste

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n API,WEB -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev --workspace @tueste/backend" "npm run dev --workspace @tueste/frontend"

scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run build && npm run test:integration
